-- Patch: grant task_status to swarm_planner. -- -- Причина: Planner использует task_status() для идемпотентной проверки -- существования графа по root_id. В step 2 грант был только у swarm_operator, -- поэтому под своей ролью Planner получал "permission denied for function -- task_status" (SQLSTATE 42501). Второй линией защиты остаётся перехват -- unique_violation (23505) на вставке корня — он ловит гонку. -- -- Применять ПОСЛЕ roles.sql и roles_2b.sql. -- roles.sql не меняем — он принят в step 2.
grant execute on function task_status(int) to swarm_planner;

# Stage 1: builder # ВНИМАНИЕ: образ поднят с 1.80 до 1.98. # Причина: транзитивная зависимость sha2 0.11 (через postgres-protocol 0.6.12 -> # digest 0.11 -> block-buffer 0.12) требует Cargo feature `edition2024`, # которая стабилизирована только с Rust 1.85. На 1.80 сборка падает с ошибкой # "feature `edition2024` is required". 1.98 соответствует локально проверенному toolchain. FROM rust:1.98-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock* ./ COPY crates ./crates RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ pkg-config libssl-dev \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \ && cargo build --release --locked --bins
# Stage 2: runtime FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ ca-certificates libssl3 \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \ && useradd -u 1001 -m -s /bin/bash swarm
USER 1001 WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-watchdog /usr/local/bin/ COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-worker /usr/local/bin/ COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-cli /usr/local/bin/ COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-planner /usr/local/bin/
# Для worker: изоляция # cap_drop, read_only, no-new-privileges задаются в compose CMD ["swarm-watchdog"]

# sandbox/Dockerfile — образ песочницы для shell tools (ТЗ v0.4 §3). # # Один образ — много контейнеров: `docker run ... agent-sandbox:1.85 sleep infinity`. # Изоляция задаётся флагами запуска (см. crates/swarm-worker/src/sandbox.rs): # --cap-drop ALL --read-only --network none --security-opt no-new-privileges:true # --tmpfs /workspace --memory 2g --cpus 2 -u 1001:1001 # # Сборка: docker build -t agent-sandbox:1.85 sandbox/
FROM ubuntu:24.04
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# Минимальный набор инструментов. curl — только на время установки rustup, # затем удаляется (его нет в allowlist и он не нужен в песочнице). RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ bash coreutils git ca-certificates build-essential curl \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Непривилегированный пользователь (uid совпадает с -u 1001:1001 в worker). RUN useradd -u 1001 -m -s /bin/bash swarm
# Rust toolchain ставим ОТ ИМЕНИ swarm — иначе /root/.cargo недоступен пользователю 1001. USER 1001 ENV HOME=/home/swarm ENV RUSTUP_HOME=/home/swarm/.rustup ENV CARGO_HOME=/home/swarm/.cargo RUN curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs \ | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain 1.85 --profile minimal \ && /home/swarm/.cargo/bin/cargo --version \ && /home/swarm/.cargo/bin/rustc --version ENV PATH="/home/swarm/.cargo/bin:${PATH}"
# curl больше не нужен (и не должен быть доступен из песочницы). USER root RUN apt-get purge -y curl && apt-get autoremove -y \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* USER 1001
# Корень образа read-only, поэтому кэш/сборка должны жить в writable tmpfs. # Воркер переопределяет эти переменные на /workspace (см. build_run_args). ENV CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/target
WORKDIR /workspace CMD ["sleep", "infinity"]

services: postgres: image: postgres:16.4-alpine environment: POSTGRES_DB: swarm POSTGRES_USER: swarm POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:?set DB_PASSWORD} SWARM_PW_WORKER: ${SWARM_PW_WORKER:?set SWARM_PW_WORKER} SWARM_PW_WATCHDOG: ${SWARM_PW_WATCHDOG:?set SWARM_PW_WATCHDOG} SWARM_PW_PLANNER: ${SWARM_PW_PLANNER:?set SWARM_PW_PLANNER} SWARM_PW_REVIEWER: ${SWARM_PW_REVIEWER:?set SWARM_PW_REVIEWER} SWARM_PW_OPERATOR: ${SWARM_PW_OPERATOR:?set SWARM_PW_OPERATOR} SWARM_PW_CLI: ${SWARM_PW_CLI:?set SWARM_PW_CLI} SWARM_PW_W1: ${SWARM_PW_W1:?set SWARM_PW_W1} SWARM_PW_W2: ${SWARM_PW_W2:?set SWARM_PW_W2} SWARM_PW_W_1: ${SWARM_PW_W_1:?set SWARM_PW_W_1} SWARM_PW_GPU_1: ${SWARM_PW_GPU_1:?set SWARM_PW_GPU_1} volumes: - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data - ./schema/schema_v0.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql:ro - ./step2/roles.sql:/sql/roles.sql:ro - ./scripts/02-roles.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02-roles.sh:ro - ./step2b/roles_2b.sql:/sql/roles_2b.sql:ro - ./scripts/03-roles-2b.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/03-roles-2b.sh:ro - ./step2/roles_patch_planner_status.sql:/sql/roles_patch_planner_status.sql:ro - ./step2/roles_patch_tool_call_audit.sql:/sql/roles_patch_tool_call_audit.sql:ro - ./scripts/03-role-patches.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/04-role-patches.sh:ro healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U swarm -d swarm"] interval: 5s timeout: 5s retries: 5
watchdog: build: . command: ["swarm-watchdog"] environment: # Раздельный DSN по сервисам (step 1/2): роль swarm_watchdog. DATABASE_URL: postgres://swarm_watchdog:${SWARM_PW_WATCHDOG}@postgres:5432/swarm WATCHDOG_INTERVAL: "10" RUST_LOG: swarm_watchdog=info depends_on: postgres: condition: service_healthy
worker-1: build: . command: ["swarm-worker"] environment: # Роль swarm_worker_w1 (step 2b). WORKER_ID обязан совпадать с ролью: # normalize(w1) -> swarm_worker_w1. DATABASE_URL: postgres://swarm_worker_w1:${SWARM_PW_W1}@postgres:5432/swarm WORKER_ID: w1 WORK_SECONDS: "5" LEASE_SEC: "10" CRASH_AFTER_CLAIM: "0" ARTIFACTS_DIR: /var/swarm/artifacts LLM_PROVIDER: ${WORKER_LLM_PROVIDER:-mock} LLM_BASE_URL: ${WORKER_LLM_BASE_URL:-} LLM_API_KEY: ${WORKER_LLM_API_KEY:-} LLM_MODEL: ${WORKER_LLM_MODEL:-mock} # v0.4: shell tools + Docker sandbox. # ВНИМАНИЕ: 1 требует доступа к Docker-сокету (docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md §6). WORKER_SHELL_TOOLS: ${WORKER_SHELL_TOOLS:-0} SANDBOX_IMAGE: ${SANDBOX_IMAGE:-agent-sandbox:1.85} WORKER_ALLOWED_COMMANDS: ${WORKER_ALLOWED_COMMANDS:-bash,cargo,git,cat,ls,echo,mkdir,touch} WORKER_CMD_TIMEOUT_SEC: ${WORKER_CMD_TIMEOUT_SEC:-60} WORKER_MAX_ITERATIONS: ${WORKER_MAX_ITERATIONS:-20} RUST_LOG: swarm_worker=info security_opt: - no-new-privileges:true cap_drop: - ALL read_only: true tmpfs: - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m - /var/swarm/artifacts:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=512m,uid=1001,gid=1001,mode=0755 depends_on: postgres: condition: service_healthy
worker-2: build: . command: ["swarm-worker"] environment: DATABASE_URL: postgres://swarm_worker_w2:${SWARM_PW_W2}@postgres:5432/swarm WORKER_ID: w2 WORK_SECONDS: "5" LEASE_SEC: "10" CRASH_AFTER_CLAIM: "1" ARTIFACTS_DIR: /var/swarm/artifacts LLM_PROVIDER: ${WORKER_LLM_PROVIDER:-mock} LLM_BASE_URL: ${WORKER_LLM_BASE_URL:-} LLM_API_KEY: ${WORKER_LLM_API_KEY:-} LLM_MODEL: ${WORKER_LLM_MODEL:-mock} RUST_LOG: swarm_worker=info security_opt: - no-new-privileges:true cap_drop: - ALL read_only: true tmpfs: - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m - /var/swarm/artifacts:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=512m,uid=1001,gid=1001,mode=0755 depends_on: postgres: condition: service_healthy
cli: build: . # command НЕ указывать — иначе compose подменяет entrypoint образа. environment: DATABASE_URL: postgres://swarm_cli:${SWARM_PW_CLI}@postgres:5432/swarm profiles: ["tools"] depends_on: postgres: condition: service_healthy
planner: build: . # Одноразовый инструмент (как cli): запускать через # docker compose run --rm --no-deps planner swarm-planner "<текст задачи>" # Не сервис: без аргумента-текста выходит с "пустой текст задачи". environment: # Роль swarm_planner; грант на task_status — roles_patch_planner_status.sql. DATABASE_URL: postgres://swarm_planner:${SWARM_PW_PLANNER}@postgres:5432/swarm PLANNER_LLM_PROVIDER: ${PLANNER_LLM_PROVIDER:-mock} PLANNER_LLM_BASE_URL: ${PLANNER_LLM_BASE_URL:-} PLANNER_LLM_API_KEY: ${PLANNER_LLM_API_KEY:-} PLANNER_LLM_MODEL: ${PLANNER_LLM_MODEL:-mock} PLANNER_MAX_TASKS: "10" PLANNER_MAX_DEPTH: "4" PLANNER_MAX_CHILDREN: "5" RUST_LOG: swarm_planner=info profiles: ["tools"] depends_on: postgres: condition: service_healthy
volumes: postgres_data:

"""Тесты инвариантов schema_v0.sql на реальном Postgres 16.
Запуск: PGDSN="dbname=v0test user=postgres host=localhost password=pw" pytest -q test_v0.py Схема должна быть уже загружена в БД. Каждый тест начинает с пустых таблиц. """ import json import os import threading import uuid
import psycopg2 import psycopg2.errors import pytest from psycopg2 import errors
DSN = os.environ.get("PGDSN", "dbname=v0test user=postgres host=localhost password=pw")
def conn(): c = psycopg2.connect(DSN) c.autocommit = False return c
def code(exc): return exc.value.pgcode
@pytest.fixture def db(): c = conn() cur = c.cursor() cur.execute("truncate events, reviews, task_deps, artifacts, tasks, workers cascade") c.commit() yield c c.rollback() c.close()
def one(c, sql, *args): cur = c.cursor() cur.execute(sql, args) r = cur.fetchone() return r[0] if r and len(r) == 1 else r
def rows(c, sql, *args): cur = c.cursor() cur.execute(sql, args) return cur.fetchall()
def contract(needs=None, budget=None, checks=None): return json.dumps({ "kind": "t", "needs": needs if needs is not None else {}, "budget": budget if budget is not None else {"attempts": 3}, "checks": checks if checks is not None else [{"type": "cmd", "run": "true"}], })
def new_task(c, root=None, ctr=None, prio=0, state=None, cap=1000): tid = str(uuid.uuid4()) cur = c.cursor() cur.execute("select add_task(%s, %s, %s::jsonb, %s, %s)", (tid, root, ctr or contract(), cap, prio)) if state: cur.execute("update tasks set state=%s where id=%s", (state, tid)) c.commit() return tid
def worker(c, wid="w1", ram=16, coder=2, tags=()): cur = c.cursor() cur.execute("select register_worker(%s, %s::jsonb, %s)", (wid, json.dumps({"ram_gb": ram, "models": {"coder_class": coder}}), list(tags))) c.commit()
def ready(c, *ids): """pending -> ready через планировщик.""" one(c, "select promote_ready()") c.commit() for i in ids: assert one(c, "select state from tasks where id=%s", i) == "ready"
def claim(c, wid="w1"): r = rows(c, "select * from claim_task(%s)", wid) c.commit() return r[0] if r else None
def expire(c, tid): cur = c.cursor() cur.execute("update tasks set lease_until = now() - interval '1 second' where id=%s", (tid,)) c.commit()
# ---------------- DDL-инварианты ---------------- def test_state_check_rejects_garbage(db): t = new_task(db) with pytest.raises(errors.CheckViolation): db.cursor().execute("update tasks set state='banana' where id=%s", (t,))
def test_lease_invariant(db): t = new_task(db) with pytest.raises(errors.CheckViolation): db.cursor().execute("update tasks set state='leased' where id=%s", (t,))
def test_contract_requires_checks_and_numeric_needs(db): for bad in [{"checks": []}, {"kind": "x"}, {"checks": [{"a": 1}], "needs": {"min_ram_gb": "lots"}}, {"checks": [{"a": 1}], "budget": {"attempts": "x"}}]: with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select add_task(%s,null,%s::jsonb,100,0)", (str(uuid.uuid4()), json.dumps(bad))) assert code(e) == "CT001" db.rollback()
def test_worker_validation(db): with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select register_worker('x', '{\"ram_gb\":\"abc\"}'::jsonb)") assert code(e) == "WK001"
# ---------------- claim ---------------- def test_claim_empty_needs_is_claimable(db): """Регрессия: задача без needs не должна отфильтровываться NULL-ом.""" worker(db) t = new_task(db, ctr=contract(needs={})) ready(db, t) r = claim(db) assert r and str(r[0]) == t and r[2] == 1
def test_claim_hard_filters(db): worker(db, ram=16, coder=2) big = new_task(db, ctr=contract(needs={"min_ram_gb": 64})) smart = new_task(db, ctr=contract(needs={"coder_class": 3})) ok = new_task(db, ctr=contract(needs={"min_ram_gb": 8, "coder_class": 1})) ready(db, big, smart, ok) assert str(claim(db)[0]) == ok assert claim(db) is None assert one(db, "select state from tasks where id=%s", big) == "ready"
def test_claim_affinity_then_priority(db): worker(db, tags=["local"]) plain = new_task(db, ctr=contract(needs={}), prio=9) tagged = new_task(db, ctr=contract(needs={"affinity_tags": ["local"]}), prio=0) ready(db, plain, tagged) assert str(claim(db)[0]) == tagged # affinity сильнее priority (осознанное решение) assert str(claim(db)[0]) == plain
def test_claim_unknown_worker(db): with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select * from claim_task('nobody')") assert code(e) == "WK002"
def test_claim_writes_event_atomically(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db) ready(db, t) claim(db) kinds = [r[0] for r in rows(db, "select kind from events where task_id=%s order by seq", t)] assert kinds == ["created", "promoted", "claimed"] assert one(db, "select verify_chain(%s)", t) is True
def test_concurrent_claims_never_double_assign(db): N, W = 24, 8 for i in range(W): worker(db, f"w{i}") ids = [new_task(db) for _ in range(N)] ready(db, *ids) got, lock = [], threading.Lock()
def run(wid): c = conn() while True: r = rows(c, "select * from claim_task(%s)", wid) c.commit() if not r: break with lock: got.append(str(r[0][0])) c.close()
ts = [threading.Thread(target=run, args=(f"w{i}",)) for i in range(W)] [t.start() for t in ts] [t.join() for t in ts] assert len(got) == N and len(set(got)) == N
# ---------------- аренды и fencing ---------------- def test_lease_durations_must_be_positive(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db) ready(db, t) with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select claim_task('w1', 0)") assert code(e) == "CT001" db.rollback() r = claim(db) with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select heartbeat(%s,'w1',%s,0)", (t, r[2])) assert code(e) == "CT001" db.rollback()
def test_heartbeat_extends_and_cannot_revive(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db) ready(db, t) r = claim(db) before = one(db, "select lease_until from tasks where id=%s", t) assert one(db, "select heartbeat(%s,'w1',%s,600)", t, r[2]) is True db.commit() assert one(db, "select lease_until from tasks where id=%s", t) > before expire(db, t) assert one(db, "select heartbeat(%s,'w1',%s,600)", t, r[2]) is False # зомби не оживает
def test_zombie_is_fenced_after_reclaim(db): worker(db, "w1") worker(db, "w2") t = new_task(db) ready(db, t) r1 = claim(db, "w1") expire(db, t) assert one(db, "select reclaim_expired()") == 1 db.commit() assert one(db, "select state from tasks where id=%s", t) == "ready" with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select save_artifact(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:aa','/p')", (t, r1[2])) assert code(e) == "LS001" db.rollback() r2 = claim(db, "w2") assert r2[2] > r1[2] one(db, "select save_artifact(%s,'w2',%s,'sha256:bb','/p')", t, r2[2]) assert one(db, "select complete_task(%s,'w2',%s,'sha256:bb',10)", t, r2[2]) == "review" db.commit() with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: # старый epoch после всего db.cursor().execute("select complete_task(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:aa',10)", (t, r1[2])) assert code(e) == "LS001"
def test_same_worker_old_epoch_is_fenced(db): """Единственный случай, где решает именно epoch: владелец и состояние совпадают, отличается только поколение аренды (воркер перезапустился и взял задачу снова).""" worker(db, "w1") t = new_task(db) ready(db, t) old = claim(db, "w1") expire(db, t) one(db, "select reclaim_expired()") db.commit() new = claim(db, "w1") assert new[2] > old[2] for sql in ["select save_artifact(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:old','/p')", "select complete_task(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:old',1)"]: with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute(sql, (t, old[2])) assert code(e) == "LS001" db.rollback() assert one(db, "select heartbeat(%s,'w1',%s,60)", t, old[2]) is False assert one(db, "select heartbeat(%s,'w1',%s,60)", t, new[2]) is True
def test_complete_requires_existing_artifact(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db) ready(db, t) r = claim(db) with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select complete_task(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:none',1)", (t, r[2])) assert code(e) == "AR001"
def test_attempts_only_grow_on_reclaim_and_cap_blocks(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db, ctr=contract(budget={"attempts": 2})) ready(db, t) claim(db) assert one(db, "select attempts from tasks where id=%s", t) == 0 # claim не считает попытки expire(db, t) one(db, "select reclaim_expired()") db.commit() assert one(db, "select state, attempts from tasks where id=%s", t) == ("ready", 1) claim(db) expire(db, t) one(db, "select reclaim_expired()") db.commit() st, reason = rows(db, "select state, block_reason from tasks where id=%s", t)[0] assert (st, reason) == ("blocked", "max_attempts")
def test_budget_exhaustion_blocks_on_complete(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db, cap=100) ready(db, t) r = claim(db) one(db, "select save_artifact(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:a','/p')", t, r[2]) assert one(db, "select complete_task(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:a',150)", t, r[2]) == "blocked"
def test_complete_rejects_negative_tokens(db): """P0-5: negative tokens must not refund/erase spent budget.""" worker(db) t = new_task(db, cap=100) ready(db, t) r = claim(db) one(db, "select save_artifact(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:a','/p')", t, r[2]) with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select complete_task(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:a',-100)", (t, r[2])) assert code(e) == "CT001" db.rollback() # state and spent_tokens untouched st, spent = rows(db, "select state, spent_tokens from tasks where id=%s", t)[0] assert (st, spent) == ("leased", 0)
# ---------------- ревью ---------------- def to_review(db, t, wid="w1"): r = claim(db, wid) one(db, "select save_artifact(%s,%s,%s,'sha256:a','/p')", t, wid, r[2]) one(db, "select complete_task(%s,%s,%s,'sha256:a',1)", t, wid, r[2]) db.commit()
PASS = json.dumps([{"type": "cmd", "status": "pass", "exit_code": 0}]) FAIL = json.dumps([{"type": "cmd", "status": "fail", "exit_code": 1}])
def test_review_rules(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db) ready(db, t) to_review(db, t) for args, exp in [(("sha256:zzz", "rev", "approved", PASS), "RV001"), # устаревший хэш (("sha256:a", "w1", "approved", PASS), "RV002"), # автор = рецензент (("sha256:a", "rev", "approved", FAIL), "RV003")]: # гейты не прошли with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select submit_review(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s::jsonb)", (t, *args)) assert code(e) == exp db.rollback() assert one(db, "select submit_review(%s,'sha256:a','rev','approved',%s::jsonb)", t, PASS) == "done"
def test_rework_does_not_touch_attempts_and_caps(db): worker(db) t = new_task(db, ctr=contract(budget={"attempts": 3, "max_rework": 1})) ready(db, t) to_review(db, t) assert one(db, "select submit_review(%s,'sha256:a','rev','changes_requested',%s::jsonb)", t, FAIL) == "ready" db.commit() assert rows(db, "select attempts, rework from tasks where id=%s", t)[0] == (0, 1) claim(db) # повторная выдача не меняет attempts assert one(db, "select attempts from tasks where id=%s", t) == 0 r = rows(db, "select lease_epoch from tasks where id=%s", t)[0][0] one(db, "select save_artifact(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:b','/p')", t, r) one(db, "select complete_task(%s,'w1',%s,'sha256:b',1)", t, r) db.commit() assert one(db, "select submit_review(%s,'sha256:b','rev','changes_requested',%s::jsonb)", t, FAIL) == "blocked"
def test_done_promotes_dependents_and_promote_is_idempotent(db): worker(db) a = new_task(db) b = new_task(db, root=a) one(db, "select add_dep(%s,%s)", b, a) db.commit() ready(db, a) assert one(db, "select state from tasks where id=%s", b) == "pending" to_review(db, a) one(db, "select submit_review(%s,'sha256:a','rev','approved',%s::jsonb)", a, PASS) db.commit() assert one(db, "select state from tasks where id=%s", b) == "ready" assert one(db, "select promote_ready()") == 0 assert rows(db, "select count(*) from events where task_id=%s and kind='promoted'", b)[0][0] == 1
# ---------------- граф ---------------- def chain(db, n, **budget): root = new_task(db, ctr=contract(budget={"attempts": 3, **budget})) ids = [root] for _ in range(n - 1): t = new_task(db, root=root) one(db, "select add_dep(%s,%s)", t, ids[-1]) db.commit() ids.append(t) return ids
def test_cycle_rejected(db): ids = chain(db, 4) for a, b in [(ids[0], ids[3]), (ids[0], ids[0])]: with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: db.cursor().execute("select add_dep(%s,%s)", (a, b)) assert code(e) == "GR001" db.rollback()
def test_concurrent_opposite_edges_exactly_one_wins(db): root = new_task(db) a, b = new_task(db, root=root), new_task(db, root=root) barrier = threading.Barrier(2) res = []
def run(x, y): c = conn() barrier.wait() try: one(c, "select add_dep(%s,%s)", x, y) c.commit() res.append("ok") except psycopg2.Error as e: c.rollback() res.append(e.pgcode) c.close()
ts = [threading.Thread(target=run, args=(a, b)), threading.Thread(target=run, args=(b, a))] [t.start() for t in ts] [t.join() for t in ts] assert sorted(res) == ["GR001", "ok"]

def test_cascade_blocks_subtree_and_fences_workers(db): worker(db) r, a, b = chain(db, 3) x = new_task(db, root=r) # независимая ветка cur = db.cursor() cur.execute("update tasks set state='done' where id in (%s,%s,%s)", (r, a, x)) cur.execute("update tasks set state='leased', lease_owner='w1', lease_epoch=5, " "lease_until=now()+interval '1 hour' where id=%s", (b,)) db.commit() assert one(db, "select reopen_task(%s,'op')", r) == 2 db.commit() st = dict(rows(db, "select id::text, state from tasks")) assert (st[r], st[a], st[b], st[x]) == ("ready", "blocked", "blocked", "done") with pytest.raises(psycopg2.Error) as e: # живой воркер ветки B отсечён db.cursor().execute("select save_artifact(%s,'w1',5,'sha256:q','/p')", (b,)) assert code(e) == "LS001" db.rollback() assert one(db, "select unblock_task(%s,'op')", a) == "pending"

"""Тесты разделения ролей (roles.sql) на реальном Postgres 16.
Запуск (БД с применёнными schema_v0.sql и roles.sql, пароли pw_<роль>): ROLES_DB=v0roles ROLES_HOST=localhost ADMIN_PW=pw pytest -q test_roles.py
Правило классификации: вызов «разрешён», если ошибка НЕ 42501 (insufficient_privilege). Доменные ошибки функций (GR000, LS001 и т.п.) на пустых данных ожидаемы и значат, что доступ есть. 42501 изнутри функции (нет прав на таблицу) тоже считается отказом. """ import json import os import uuid
import psycopg2 import pytest from psycopg2 import errors
DB = os.environ.get("ROLES_DB", "v0roles") HOST = os.environ.get("ROLES_HOST", "localhost") PORT = int(os.environ.get("ROLES_PORT", "5432")) ADMIN_PW = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PW", "pw") ROLES = ["swarm_worker_w1", "swarm_watchdog", "swarm_planner", "swarm_reviewer", "swarm_operator", "swarm_cli"] DENIED = "42501"
def connect(user, pw): c = psycopg2.connect(host=HOST, port=PORT, dbname=DB, user=user, password=pw) c.autocommit = True return c
def as_role(role): if role.startswith("swarm_worker_"): suffix = role.removeprefix("swarm_worker_") else: suffix = role.split("_", 1)[1] return connect(role, os.environ.get("SWARM_PW_" + suffix.upper(), "pw_" + suffix))
@pytest.fixture def admin(): c = connect("postgres", ADMIN_PW) c.cursor().execute("truncate events, reviews, task_deps, artifacts, tasks, workers cascade") yield c c.close()
def attempt(conn, sql): """None если выполнено; иначе SQLSTATE.""" try: conn.cursor().execute(sql) return None except psycopg2.Error as e: return e.pgcode
U = "'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'" CONTRACT = json.dumps({"kind": "t", "checks": [{"type": "cmd"}], "budget": {"attempts": 3}})
CALLS = { "claim_task": "select * from claim_task('w1', 10)", "heartbeat": f"select heartbeat({U}, 'w1', 1, 10)", "save_artifact": f"select save_artifact({U}, 'w1', 1, 'sha256:a', '/p')", "complete_task": f"select complete_task({U}, 'w1', 1, 'sha256:a', 1)", "register_worker": "select register_worker('w-reg', '{\"ram_gb\":8}'::jsonb)", "reclaim_expired": "select reclaim_expired()", "promote_ready": "select promote_ready()", "add_task": f"select add_task('{uuid.uuid4()}', null, '{CONTRACT}'::jsonb, 100, 0)", "add_dep": f"select add_dep({U}, {U.replace('1', '2')})", "submit_review": f"select submit_review({U}, 'sha256:a', 'rev', 'approved', '[]'::jsonb)", "verify_chain": f"select verify_chain({U})", "reopen_task": f"select reopen_task({U}, 'op')", "unblock_task": f"select unblock_task({U}, 'op')", "task_status": "select * from task_status(10)", } INTERNAL = { "append_event": f"select append_event({U}, 'e', 'claimed', 'x')", "assert_lease": f"select assert_lease({U}, 'w1', 1)", "lock_root": f"select lock_root({U})", "validate_contract": f"select validate_contract('{CONTRACT}'::jsonb)", "event_hash": f"select event_hash(null, {U}, 'e', 'claimed', 'x', '{{}}'::jsonb, now())", "c_num": "select c_num('{}'::jsonb, '{a}', 0)", }
ALLOWED = { "swarm_worker_w1": {"claim_task", "heartbeat", "save_artifact", "complete_task", "register_worker"}, "swarm_watchdog": {"reclaim_expired", "promote_ready"}, "swarm_planner": {"add_task", "add_dep", "promote_ready", "task_status"}, "swarm_reviewer": {"submit_review", "verify_chain"}, "swarm_operator": {"reopen_task", "unblock_task", "verify_chain", "task_status"}, } ALLOWED["swarm_cli"] = ALLOWED["swarm_planner"] | ALLOWED["swarm_reviewer"] | ALLOWED["swarm_operator"]
@pytest.mark.parametrize("role", ROLES) def test_function_matrix(admin, role): """Каждая роль может ровно свои функции: ни больше, ни меньше.""" conn = as_role(role) for fn, sql in CALLS.items(): code = attempt(conn, sql) if fn in ALLOWED[role]: assert code != DENIED, f"{role} должна мочь {fn}, получила {code}" else: assert code == DENIED, f"{role} НЕ должна мочь {fn}, получила {code}"
@pytest.mark.parametrize("role", ROLES) def test_internal_functions_closed_for_everyone(admin, role): conn = as_role(role) for fn, sql in INTERNAL.items(): assert attempt(conn, sql) == DENIED, f"{role} вызвала внутреннюю {fn}"
@pytest.mark.parametrize("role", ROLES) def test_no_direct_table_access(admin, role): conn = as_role(role) cols = {"tasks": "id", "events": "seq", "artifacts": "ref", "task_deps": "task_id", "workers": "id", "reviews": "id"} for t, col in cols.items(): for sql in [f"select 1 from {t} limit 1", f"delete from {t}", f"truncate {t}", f"update {t} set {col} = {col}"]: assert attempt(conn, sql) == DENIED, f"{role}: `{sql}` не должно выполняться" assert attempt(conn, "insert into events(task_id,event_id,kind,at,hash) " f"values ({U},'x','claimed',now(),'\\x00')") == DENIED
@pytest.mark.parametrize("role", ROLES) def test_no_ddl_in_public(admin, role): conn = as_role(role) assert attempt(conn, "create table public.x(i int)") == DENIED assert attempt(conn, "create function public.evil() returns int language sql as 'select 1'") == DENIED
